$comment: Every outside service the product or the Harness Monitor reaches (docs/testing-strategy.md, "Third-party dependencies"). A service claims its hosts and names a live contract suite in `suite`, or has a `gap` saying why there is none yet; a gap comes off when the suite lands. A host in product or Harness Monitor source that nothing here claims fails scripts/lib/outside-services.test.mjs. A service reached through an SDK or a binding has no host to scan, so it is listed here by hand. `notServices` excuses a host that is not a call, with the reason.

services.name: Twilio Verify
services.gap: Each check sends a real, paid text to a phone, so a contract suite needs a number and a budget decided first.

services.name: GitHub API
services.gap: No contract suite yet. One would read the Harness Monitor's GraphQL query for a repository's pull requests and check runs against the live API, and the LiteLLM price file against what readLiteLlm expects.

notServices.reason: A link Cockpit builds to open a message in Gmail, never called.
A link Cockpit builds to open a message in Outlook, never called.
A link Cockpit builds to open a Teams conversation, never called.
